title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: The family celebrates Pallavan's success at a restaurant, but Chandayatha refuses to eat. Nila tries to cheer her up for everyone's sake, but Cheran's words still deeply hurt her.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi and Malar successfully deceive Thangaraj into taking Revathi to the cinema. Finally, delighted to fulfil her long-awaited wish, Lakshmi enjoys the movie with them.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 72: Mukesh Ruins the Task
description: Operation Rescue begins with the housemates listing whom to save from the bus blast. Mukesh’s gameplay wipes out all points, and BB orders a restart amidst fresh fights.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Blaming Aishwarya for ruining her own life and getting Eshwari jailed, her parents drive her out of their home. Consumed by guilt, Sethupathi heads to Tamizhselvi's house.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Pooja decides to leave Karikalan's home after revealing her love for Aadhavan. Saranya joyfully celebrates her birthday as Karikalan joins and gifts her a gold ring.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: At a private meeting, the judge assures Kanmani of a quick divorce from Anbu at Mathangi's insistence. Then, Kanmani grows closer to Anbu during their maternity shoot.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Despite Abhi's strong objections, Kandhasamy decides to give Murugan the catering order for the reception. Later, he manages to convince Azhagappan to accept his decision.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: After finding Pandian drunk, Gomathi cleverly manages to keep it from others. Then, Pandian emotionally expresses how she brings meaning to his life, leaving her touched.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sakthivel tricks Manoj's family and takes the suitcase containing Devika's cash and gold. Manoj tells Devika about Kanaga's strange behaviour after their Ooty trip.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri lands in trouble after being framed for misbehaving with Sandhya, leading to his expulsion from office. Later, Vethanayagam angrily confronts him over the incident.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Senthamizh skips college for an outing with Thennavan, but Azhagar spots them and follows. Meanwhile, Manjamalai and Sudalai are shocked to learn she missed class.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma's decision to legally adopt Paraman shocks everyone. Ilamathi warns him of her motives, but he refuses to listen, while Sidharth angrily confronts Kalamma over her plan.
